implementation: Typed active-document zoom mode and prompt/applied query project independent persistent FIT PAGE and SEARCH badges.
One footer renderer retains current diagnostics alongside pending input and does not rebuild unchanged nodes.
Scalar content query forwarding does not copy search result arrays.
Search producers tag owned messages; clearing never clears an untagged newer message, including identical wording.
Keyboard ownership is synchronized before shell publication, including input during asynchronous tab deactivation.
warningsAndRetries: Initial unrestricted Rust test compilation exhausted memory and produced metadata/rlib failures; bounded single-job rerun passed without source or assertion suppression.
Initial asset sync found no worktree-local pdfjs-dist; npm ci installed the lockfile-local dependencies before successful builds.
Vite reports a bundle larger than 500 kB; Node PDF.js tests recommend the legacy build; Windows linker reports import-library creation output. These warnings were not suppressed.

Initial full frontend run caught the fixed-row source contract and a duplicate forced-colors block; the row assertion was updated for deliberate diagnostic wrapping and badge rules were moved into the existing forced-colors block.

browserLayout.runtime: Hidden Chromium with production ShellStatusRenderer, app.css and seven existing theme palettes
browserLayout.diagnostic: PDF registry cleanup failed: followed by five repetitions of very-long-diagnostic-without-truncation
browserLayout.contrastMethod: Computed sRGB foreground/background colors sampled through a one-pixel canvas, WCAG relative luminance ratio
browserLayout.forcedColors: CDP Emulation.setEmulatedMedia forced-colors=active at 480x360, DPR 2, footer text 24px: CanvasText/Canvas, solid FIT PAGE and dashed SEARCH borders, no badge focus targets
browserLayout.limitation: DPR and footer font-size emulation are not native monitor DPI or Windows accessibility text-scale certification.

native.runtime: Standalone Tauri debug executable, bundled frontend/PDF.js, real WebView2 and native argv PDF transport
native.isolation: Separate application identifier avoids changing the ordinary application's durable state. No IPC implementation or PDF transport is mocked.
native.driver: Loopback-only WebView2 CDP attachment. Final recheck invokes production menu click handlers and dispatches prompt Enter/Escape events; these are not physical keyboard acceptance evidence.
finalBuildChecks: Fit Page shows FIT PAGE; prompt-only search shows both badges.
Prompt Escape with no applied query removes SEARCH.
Applied no-match query closes prompt but retains both badges and No matches diagnostic.
Clear Search removes search-owned No matches wording and SEARCH, retaining FIT PAGE.
Minimum native window retains full no-match diagnostic and both non-focusable badges.
Owned window closes through native WM_CLOSE and exits within 15 seconds.
earlierBuildChecks: Trusted CDP keyboard events exercised prompt Escape, applied query, Fit Width and custom zoom.

Native single-instance argv opened the second immutable fixture; A Pending:g to B and B Pending:g to active close retained no foreign prefix; A's FIT PAGE/SEARCH restored. The later deferred-deactivation race fix has separate automated coverage.
OS SendKeys/keybd_event smoke attempts did not reliably dispatch to the reader and are not counted as passed keyboard tests.
native.screenshotScope: WebView content captures, not native titlebar screenshots. Native titlebar configuration is unchanged.

review: Independent read-only architect review: CLEAR after correcting entry-time and asynchronous handoff prefix ownership races.
remainingGates: Native 100/125/150/200% monitor DPI matrix and monitor moves
Windows 200% accessibility text-scale and OS high-contrast matrix across all themes
Narrator audible duplicate-announcement and focus audit
Physical Enter/IME/Escape/pending keyboard acceptance on an interactive Windows desktop
delivery: Draft PR until remaining native acceptance is completed; no broader parity or release claim.
